California officials discover mass graves of dog bodies at 'no-kill' sanctuary

A northern California animal rescue sanctuary, Miranda's Rescue, has been found to have 117 dead dogs with evidence of gunshots. Police are investigating the cause of the deaths and have also discovered over 600 missing dog collars on the premises.
